user.title: Guest page
user.description: Guests control the property with the code from their booking. Each booking is a calendar event with arrival and departure times; the integration adds a `code: …` line itself. With `code: geen` an event never gets a code.

data.hours_before: Code valid from (hours before the start)
data.hours_after: Code valid until (hours after the end)
data.max_attempts: Wrong attempts per 15 minutes per address

abort.single_instance_allowed: The guest page is already set up.

error.invalid_prefix: Letters and digits only, at most 6.

init.title: Guest page

data.hours_before: Code valid from (hours before the start)
data.hours_after: Code valid until (hours after the end)
data.max_attempts: Wrong attempts per 15 minutes per address

init.description: Owner codes: {owners}. Manage them with the actions gastpagina.add_owner_code, remove_owner_code and list_owner_codes (Developer tools → Actions); the codes themselves can never be read back.

error.invalid_prefix: Letters and digits only, at most 6.

config_missing.title: gastpagina.yaml is missing
config_missing.description: Create {path} with the rooms and devices, then call `gastpagina.reload`. Until then guests cannot control anything.

config_invalid.title: gastpagina.yaml is invalid
config_invalid.description: The file could not be read: {error}. The previous devices keep working until it is fixed.

wrong_domain.title: Wrong kind of entity for {device}
wrong_domain.description: {entity} is not a {expected}. The device is skipped and unreachable for guests.

duplicate_key.title: Duplicate key in gastpagina.yaml
duplicate_key.description: {device} occurs more than once (or is reserved). Only the first one counts.

missing_entity.title: Entity for {device} does not exist
missing_entity.description: {entity} does not exist in Home Assistant. The device shows as unavailable on the page.

limits_invalid.title: Invalid temperature limits
limits_invalid.description: climate_limits in gastpagina.yaml is wrong ({error}). The default 16–22 °C applies.

code_too_short.title: Code too short for booking {title}
code_too_short.description: The code of booking "{title}" is shorter than {min_length} characters and does not work. Pick a longer one.

duplicate_code.title: Same code for two bookings
duplicate_code.description: "{first}" and "{second}" overlap and share a code. Neither works until one changes.

calendar_missing.title: Guest page calendar is missing
calendar_missing.description: {entity} does not exist (any more). Without it no code works.

calendar_read_only.title: The calendar cannot be written to
calendar_read_only.description: {entity} cannot update events, so codes are not created automatically. Add a `code: …` line yourself, or turn off *Create codes automatically*.

all_day_booking.title: Booking {title} is an all-day event
all_day_booking.description: Give arrival and departure times and the booking gets a code by itself. If it is not a booking, put `code: geen` in the description.

recurring_booking.title: Booking {title} is a recurring event
recurring_booking.description: Recurring events get no code. Make separate events, or put `code: geen` in the description.

code_write_failed.title: Could not save the code for {title}
code_write_failed.description: Writing to the calendar failed three times. It is retried every minute; see the log for the error.

owner_code_clash.title: Code of booking {title} is an owner code
owner_code_clash.description: This booking does not work while its code equals an owner code. Give the booking another code (or call gastpagina.generate_code); the owner code keeps working.

revoke_sessions.name: Revoke sessions
revoke_sessions.description: Signs guests out: without a booking, all of them. Owners only with 'Owners too'.

booking.name: Booking
booking.description: Title or uid of the calendar event.

generate_code.name: New code
generate_code.description: Makes a new code for one booking (e.g. when the old one leaked), replaces the `code: …` line and signs that booking's guests out.

booking.name: Booking
booking.description: Title or uid of the calendar event.

fill_codes.name: Fill in codes
fill_codes.description: Gives every upcoming booking without a code one right now.

add_owner_code.name: Add owner code
add_owner_code.description: A code for an owner that always works, also outside bookings and with access off. Without a code the integration makes one and returns it once: keep it in your password manager. An existing name gets a new code and is signed out.

remove_owner_code.name: Remove owner code
remove_owner_code.description: Removes the code and signs that owner out at once.

list_owner_codes.name: List owner codes
list_owner_codes.description: Names, creation date and last use; never the codes.

not_loaded.message: The guest page is not loaded.

calendar_read_only.message: The calendar cannot be written to.

booking_not_found.message: No upcoming booking with title or uid "{booking}".

booking_ambiguous.message: Several bookings are called "{booking}"; give the uid.

booking_not_eligible.message: "{booking}" is an all-day or recurring event and cannot get a code.

code_write_failed.message: The new code for "{booking}" could not be saved.

owner_name_invalid.message: Give a name of 1 to 40 characters.

owner_code_too_short.message: An owner code needs at least {min_length} characters (without spaces and dashes).

owner_code_in_use.message: That code is already used by a booking or another owner.
